en.name: Lycanthrope
en.ability: Each night*, choose an alive player. If good, they die & the Demon doesn’t kill tonight. One good player registers as evil.
en.flavor: Beneath the thin veneer of civilisation lies a howling madness.

revisions.v1: Each night*, choose an alive player: if good, they die, but they are the only player that can die tonight.

zh.name: 半兽人
zh.ability:
每个夜晚*，你要选择一名存活玩家：如果他是善良的，他死亡，并且当晚恶魔不会造成死亡。
会有一名善良玩家始终被当作邪恶阵营。
